data.hypothesis: Before implementing a distinct VBMI table-permutation decoder, establish the GCC 14.2 feature requirements and whether function-local targeting/runtime dispatch can avoid relying on unspecified global flags. The supplied target is an EPYC 9654, but the frozen build flags are not provided; unconditional AVX-512 intrinsics could therefore fail to compile or execute safely. The scalar baseline is correct at a measured mean of 55.0005 µs; there is no candidate timing to compare yet.
